limit_definitions.source: registry.json limits (registered before S1) = round1/motor-precision-joint-v2.md: holding mean >= 6.0 N m AND pk-pk <= 0.30 N m absolute AND pk-pk <= 5 % of |mean|; peak mean >= 12 N m AND pk-pk <= 0.60 N m AND <= 5 % of |mean|; zero-current cogging pk-pk <= 0.05 N m absolute
limit_definitions.units: every pk-pk figure in this summary and in full-question.json is in N m (absolute), never a fraction; the 5 % rule is evaluated as pk-pk - 0.05 |mean| in N m
limit_definitions.scoring: overshoot in bands = max over: (6.0 - mean)/0.10; (pk - 0.30)/0.02; (pk - 0.05|mean|)/0.02; (12 - peak mean)/0.10; (peak pk - 0.60)/0.04; (peak pk - 0.05|peak mean|)/0.04; (cogging - 0.05)/0.02; feasible when <= 0
